projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
Build an end-to-end analytics dashboard that ingests customer CSV files (data processing), analyzes application logs, and presents insights through visualization components. The project is structured into four milestones: (1) Customer CSV data processing, (2) Application log analysis, (3) Visualization components, and (4) Dashboard integration and deployment. Each milestone is broken into small, executable tasks with clear dependencies.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: ROLLUP MILESTONE — no direct execution. Tracks the 7 child tasks that ingest, validate, clean, transform, and load customer CSV files into a query-ready dataset. Progress is measured by completion of its child tasks.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: ROLLUP MILESTONE — no direct execution. Tracks the 6 child tasks that collect, parse, and analyze application logs into operational metrics. Progress is measured by completion of its child tasks.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Visualization Components
tasks.details: ROLLUP MILESTONE — no direct execution. Tracks the 8 child tasks that build and test the reusable chart, table, KPI card, filter, and data-fetch components. Progress is measured by completion of its child tasks.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Dashboard Integration & Deployment
tasks.details: ROLLUP MILESTONE — no direct execution. Tracks the 8 child tasks that assemble, connect, secure, test, deploy, and document the dashboard. Progress is measured by completion of its child tasks.

tasks.name: Define customer CSV schema and data dictionary
tasks.details: Document every column across customer CSV files (name, type, nullability, allowed values, PII flags). Produce a data dictionary that downstream validation and transformation tasks will follow. First task in the milestone; no dependencies.

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion loader
tasks.details: Implement a loader that discovers/reads customer CSV files (including batch uploads and large-file chunking) and stages raw rows. Depends on the schema definition task. Keep scope to reading and staging only; validation is a separate task.

tasks.name: Implement data validation and error reporting
tasks.details: Validate staged rows against the data dictionary (types, required fields, formats, ranges). Collect row-level errors into a report so bad records can be quarantined rather than failing the whole batch. Depends on schema definition and ingestion loader.

tasks.name: Clean and normalize customer records
tasks.details: Deduplicate customers, standardize date/number/address formats, trim and normalize text, and handle nulls per documented rules. Output a cleaned dataset. Depends on validation task.

tasks.name: Transform customer data into analytics tables
tasks.details: Model cleaned data into analytics-ready tables (e.g., customer dimension, signup/activity facts) and compute derived fields needed by dashboards. Depends on cleaning task.

tasks.name: Load processed data into the analytics store
tasks.details: Write analytics tables into the target store with idempotent upserts and a load audit log. Depends on the transformation task.

tasks.name: Write CSV pipeline tests and sample fixtures
tasks.details: Create unit tests for validation, cleaning, and transformation plus small sample CSV fixtures covering happy path and malformed rows. Depends on all prior pipeline tasks.

tasks.name: Inventory log sources and define collection plan
tasks.details: List application log sources, formats, retention, and volume. Decide collection method (agent/streaming/pull) and define the structured log schema. First task in the milestone; no dependencies.

tasks.name: Build log collection and ingestion pipeline
tasks.details: Implement collection of application logs into a staging area based on the collection plan, including batching and retry/backoff. Depends on the log inventory task.

tasks.name: Implement log parser for structured records
tasks.details: Parse raw log lines (JSON, plaintext patterns, timestamps, severity, request IDs) into structured records; handle malformed lines gracefully. Depends on collection pipeline.

tasks.name: Compute log metrics and aggregations
tasks.details: Aggregate parsed logs into metrics: error rates, latency percentiles, request volume, top error types, and usage by endpoint. Store results in analytics tables. Depends on the parser task.

tasks.name: Implement anomaly detection rules for logs
tasks.details: Add configurable threshold/statistical rules to flag spikes in errors or latency, with outputs stored for dashboard alert widgets. Depends on log metrics task.

tasks.name: Write log analysis tests and sample log fixtures
tasks.details: Unit tests for parsing, aggregation, and anomaly rules using representative sample log files including malformed entries. Depends on prior milestone 2 tasks.

tasks.name: Define visualization requirements and component inventory
tasks.details: List the charts, tables, KPI cards, and filters the dashboard needs, map each to its data source, and define acceptance criteria. First task in the milestone; no dependencies.

tasks.name: Set up frontend and charting library scaffolding
tasks.details: Initialize the frontend app structure, add the charting library (e.g., Recharts/D3/ECharts), set up theming and a component playground. Depends on visualization requirements task.

tasks.name: Build reusable KPI card component
tasks.details: Create a KPI card supporting value, delta indicator, trend sparkline slot, loading and error states. Depends on scaffolding.

tasks.name: Build time-series chart component
tasks.details: Create a configurable line/area time-series chart with axis formatting, tooltips, legend, and empty/loading states. Depends on scaffolding.

tasks.name: Build data table component with sorting and filtering
tasks.details: Create a reusable table with column config, sorting, pagination, and basic filtering. Depends on scaffolding.

tasks.name: Build filter and control panel component
tasks.details: Create shared filter controls (date range, segment, customer cohort, log severity) that emit a single filter state for all widgets. Depends on scaffolding.

tasks.name: Implement data-fetch client for visualization components
tasks.details: Build a typed API client with caching and loading/error handling that feeds customer and log metrics into components. Depends on scaffolding and the data layer from milestones 1 and 2.

tasks.name: Write visualization component tests
tasks.details: Add component tests for KPI cards, charts, tables, and filters covering rendering, empty/loading/error states, and interactions. Depends on all component tasks.

tasks.name: Design dashboard layout and navigation
tasks.details: Produce layout wireframes, page/navigation structure (overview, customers, logs, alerts), and responsive breakpoints. Depends on visualization requirements.

tasks.name: Assemble dashboard pages from components
tasks.details: Compose the KPI cards, charts, tables, and filters into the designed pages with a shared filter state. Depends on layout design and milestone 3 components.

tasks.name: Connect dashboard to live data layer end-to-end
tasks.details: Wire pages to the production data store through the API client, verify customer and log metrics render correctly, and remove mock data. Depends on page assembly.

tasks.name: Implement access control for the dashboard
tasks.details: Add authentication and role-based access (viewer/admin) plus PII-safe display rules for customer data. Depends on live data connection.

tasks.name: Run end-to-end and performance testing
tasks.details: Execute E2E tests across ingestion-to-visualization, load-test dashboard queries, and verify page load budgets. Depends on live data connection and access control.

tasks.name: Set up CI/CD deployment pipeline
tasks.details: Create build, test, and deploy stages with environment configuration and secrets management for the dashboard and pipelines. Depends on passing E2E tests.

tasks.name: Deploy to environment and configure monitoring
tasks.details: Deploy via the pipeline, set up uptime/error alerts and pipeline freshness checks, and run a smoke test. Depends on CI/CD pipeline.

tasks.name: Write user and operational documentation
tasks.details: Document dashboard usage, data refresh cadence, pipeline runbooks, and troubleshooting steps. Depends on successful deployment.
